description: Temperature and relative humidity transmitter with LCD (wall, duct and P10 versions) and Modbus RTU over RS485: temperature, humidity, dew point, unit, offsets, display mode and communication settings
source: Novus RHT-WM-485-LCD, RHT-DM-485-LCD and RHT-P10-485-LCD instruction manual V1.0x E (Portuguese), chapter 6

sources.title: Transmissores RHT-WM-485-LCD, RHT-DM-485-LCD e RHT-P10-485-LCD - Manual de Instruções
sources.note: linked in issue #668; holding register table and sections 6.1 and 6.2

notes: Factory defaults: address 247, 1200 bit/s, even parity. The manual does not give the stop bits; 1 is assumed.
Functions 03 (read holding registers) and 06 (write single register).
Temperature, humidity, dew point and the offsets have one decimal place: 253 is 25.3. Temperature and dew point are in °C or °F, as set in register 10.
The error value (register 16, factory -9999) is what the measurements report while the sensor has a fault.
Settings can also be changed with the P button on the device; register 11 locks the communication settings against the button.
Registers 17-21 hold a user title of up to five characters; the manual does not say how the characters are packed. The model code in register 62 (0 to 11) is not described in the manual.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Temperature
registers.description: °C or °F as set in register 10; sensor range -40.0 to 100.0 °C

registers.name: Temperature unit
registers.description: Unit of the temperature and the dew point

registers.name: Temperature offset
registers.description: User correction added to the temperature, -10.0 to 10.0

registers.name: Humidity offset
registers.description: User correction added to the relative humidity, -10.0 to 10.0

registers.name: Error value
registers.description: Value reported while the sensor has a fault; factory -9999

registers.name: Serial number
registers.description: High word in register 0, low word in register 1

registers.name: Firmware version
registers.description: 0 to 999; the manual does not give the decimal point

registers.name: Model code
registers.description: 0 to 11; the codes are not listed in the manual

registers.name: Title
registers.description: User text that identifies the device
